Scientific Instruments Change - Bras d'Or Lakes - Whycocomagh
Subsurface scientific mooring deployed at 45 56.860N 061 07.440W, in 47 meters of water with height of 20 meters. Top float below surface at 27 meters depth.  Top float may periodically come to surface to transmit data, and then be winched back down underwater to 27 meter depth.
